answers.questionPrompt: Describe an electronic device you use often. Explain what it looks like, how you use it, and why it is useful in your daily life.
answers.transcript:
I use my smartphone a lot every day.
I check SNS and watch videos.
Sometimes it wastes my time.
I want to use it less.
answers.modelAnswer: I use my smartphone a lot every day, especially for SNS and watching videos. However, it often wastes my time, so I want to reduce my screen time and use it more productively.
